VisualEditorOptions.description: Settings for the Umbraco Visual Editor (a visual, on-page editor for Umbraco documents).

Enabled.description: Whether the Visual editor is offered at all.

AllowedDocumentTypes.description: Document type aliases to offer the Visual editor for. Empty (the default) means every document type with a template.

ExcludedDocumentTypes.description: Document type aliases never to offer the Visual editor for (applied after AllowedDocumentTypes). An alias can't be in both lists.
